name: Homemade Ketchup
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: ½ cup (120 g) white granulated sugar

steps: Scald tomatoes, and press through a coarse sieve to remove seeds and skins. Let cool.
Measure out 1 gallon (3.8 L) of tomato pulp, and combine with the remaining ingredients. Let simmer slowly for 3 hours.
Pour hot ketchup into hot sterilized 1-pint jars and seal. Process for 15 minutes in boiling water bath.
